{{Quote|He's here--Vitiate's presence, here on Ziost. He's taking over this outpost, controlling soldiers and Sith, using them to murder anyone he can.|Lana Beniko|<ref name="A Presence on Ziost" />}}
A '''crisis''' developed on [[Ziost/Legends|Ziost]] in [[3636 BBY]] during the [[Galactic War]], when the [[Battle of Yavin 4 (Galactic War)|reawakened]] spirit of the presumed dead [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Tenebrae|Vitiate]], manifested on the planet and took control of its population, to fuel his powers in a total manslaughter. Agents of both the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] attempted to stop him, but failed, and Vitiate obliterated all life on the planet.

==Prelude==
In the aftermath of the [[Battle of Yavin 4 (Galactic War)|battle]] against [[Order of Revan|Revanite forces]] on the [[Yavin 4/Legends|fourth moon]] of [[Yavin Prime/Legends|Yavin]], former [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Tenebrae|Darth Vitiate]], fueled by many deaths of the conflict, manifested himself and spoke to [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] and the [[Yavin Coalition|Coalition]] strike team, announcing his return. His presence became strongly felt by [[Force-sensitive/Legends|users]] of the [[The Force/Legends|Force]] participating in the Coalition,<ref>{{TORcite|exp=shadow|type=general|The Enemy Within|[[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]]}}</ref> who felt him ever since, until his eventual destruction in [[3626 BBY]].<ref>{{TORcite|exp=ons|type=general|Echoes of Oblivion|[[Mindscape|Satele Shan's Mindscape]]}}</ref> After Yavin 4, Vitiate reappeared next on the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] world of [[Ziost/Legends|Ziost]], taking control of military personnel and sith to instigate a new wave of violence for him to fuel upon.<ref name="A Presence on Ziost" />

==Crisis==
{{Quote|I sent a team in dark to investigate, maybe handle it, but it's all gone out of control now. I think it's him. The Emperor.|Theron Shan|<ref name="A Presence on Ziost" />}}
In [[3636 BBY]], following the rumors about "demented" soldiers on Ziost firing upon both slave and civilian population, a [[Republic Strategic Information Service|Republic Strategic Information Service (SIS)]] agent [[Theron Shan]] lead a covert team of SIS-alligned [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], known as the [[Sixth Line]], to the planet, to investigate. However, [[Tenebrae|Darth Vitiate]] took control of the Sixth Line, adding them to his ever-growing army of possessed. As the situation on the planet sprung into chaos, Theron Shan tried to join his ground team, but used the wrong set of clearance codes and got under heavy fire. While trying to get to safety, he contacted some of his allies to describe what he had saw and warn them against coming looking for him. At the same time, [[Minister of Sith Intelligence|Sith Intelligence Minister]] [[Lana Beniko]], also following the trail of the former Sith Emperor, found herself surrounded in a bunker under assault by the possessed. She contacted her allies as well, and as a result, a former ally of both Lana and Theron from the [[Yavin Coalition]], came to the planet hoping to deal with the situation.<ref name="A Presence on Ziost" />
{{Stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Invasion of Ziost first appeared in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as the content added in Game Update 3.2: Rise of the Emperor. Details of the invasion differ slightly between factions, and the fate of Agent Kovach is decided by the player.
